The merge seat fills the provenance fields, moves this to docs/shift-records/ and runs the door. ONE CAUSE, THREE MEASURED COMPONENTS (the residue-herald record's form): the pulse's lines read wrong, cured where each line's words are formed. (A) VISIBLE-BUGS 3a, d57f2fc22: factionCompetition.js's power-move lines fill {target} with institutionSentenceNoun (no catalogue count, condition, 'multiple' or slashed pair). (B) VISIBLE-BUGS 3b, 5aabf82c0 + 6dbf92bff: npcAgency.js's deed body gives the aim as the deed's reason in one of five frames (heraldDeeds.js :: NPC_AIM_FRAMES), picked by fnv1a32('aim-frame|<npcId>|<tick>'). (C) VISIBLE-BUGS 5, e3dac8045 (the chair's authorisation of 2026-11-12 06:29 UTC): a power's name in its pulse lines through powerSentenceName/powerPossessive (no slashed label, no plural "'s"). All three are TEXT ONLY: (B) proven over 40 seeds x 12 weeks tick by tick (21,429,758 leaves; 91,327 moved, every one a summary that held an 'is out to' body; zero other leaves); (C) proven the same way against 2a68163e4 (21,429,758 leaves; 3,800 moved, every one a text field whose old value held the slash or the "s's"; zero other leaves).
